turns.content: The product is the Fujifilm XT20 camera. It has a 40 MP sensor. It has inbuilt image stabilization, and it has film simulations.

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm XT20, featuring a 40 MP sensor for stunning image quality, inbuilt image stabilization for smooth shooting, and a variety of film simulations to enhance your creative expression. Elevate your photography experience with these exceptional features!
